summary: Enhance your Excel skills with our Essentials Training Course. Discover essential functions and techniques to streamline your work and improve efficiency.
lede: Excel Essentials training helps professionals build dependable spreadsheets for recurring analysis, reporting, and operational decisions. Learners practise cleaning and validating data, building formulas and lookups, and using PivotTables and charts to create clear reports and dashboards; they also explore refreshable Power Query workflows and workbook checks to support reliable reporting.
audienceIntro: This Excel Essentials course suits professionals who use spreadsheets for recurring analysis, reporting, administration, and operational decisions. It starts with core workbook practices and progresses to intermediate analysis without requiring programming experience.
prerequisites: This course suits foundation-to-intermediate Excel users. You should have basic keyboard and file-management skills and some experience entering data into spreadsheets. No coding, VBA, or programming experience is required. You will work with provided business datasets, and a laptop with a current desktop version of Microsoft Excel is recommended. Power Query and Power Pivot availability can vary by Excel edition, so the facilitator will provide equivalent demonstrations where required.
